messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Version 1.2.3 released
parts:
The version 1.2.3 was released:

http://www.vim.org/scripts/script.php?script_id=2628
http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/vimcom.html 

The news are:
  • Official runtime files were deleted. See: https://github.com/jalvesaq/R-Vim-runtime 
  • News options to control the Object Browser: vimrplugin_objbr_opendf, vimrplugin_objbr_openlist, vimrplugin_objbr_allnames and vimrplugin_objbr_labelerr. 
  • New option to control LaTeX compilation: vimrplugin_texerr. 
  • Fix setting of R working directory on Mac OS X.

messages.subject: Re: Version 1.2.3 released
parts:
